description.value: This study investigated bidirectional emotion regulation of threat-related emotional responses through reappraisal strategies using fMRI together with self-report and peripheral physiological measures.

value: We predicted that the amygdala would respond to threat‐related pictures and would be sensitive to regulation, in that its activity would be decreased or increased in the respective conditions in comparison to a condition of simply viewing threat‐related pictures.
The emotion induction and regulation effects should also be observable in peripheral physiological variables such as skin conductance responses (SCR) and startle eyeblink responses.
Furthermore, we expected a network of prefrontal regions, namely, the ACC, DLPFC, and OFC, to be involved in up‐ as well as downregulation.
